script_text: Hold on, Aries — Saturn is rewriting your Fire sign identity right now. Saturn is sitting in your 1st House of Self, forging a stronger version of your Fire-driven nature, slowly building a more disciplined you. Meanwhile, your ruling planet Mars is buzzing through Gemini in your 3rd House of Communication, forming a sextile to Jupiter that's opening doors through your words and ideas. In love, Neptune's lingering energy in your 12th House of Hidden Desires is pulling someone from your past back into your awareness — don't ignore that inner nudge. Career-wise, the Sun's powerful transit through your 6th House of Daily Work is spotlighting your routines — a project you've been neglecting is about to demand your full attention and reward you generously. Avoid making impulsive financial decisions after dark — your intuition is foggy in the evening hours right now. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
